visual_basis: Both cards share the exact same linework, composition, and character pose illustrated by kirisAki, featuring Volo with his hand outstretched. Image A has a Rainbow Rare treatment featuring a textured, multicolored rainbow gradient across the character and background, while Image B displays the full-color version with blonde hair, green trousers, and a blue sky with ancient pillar ruins in the background.
Both cards feature identical artwork illustrated by Mitsuhiro Arita depicting Slowpoke and Psyduck leaping out of splashing water with the same linework, colors, lighting, and background details.

The artwork in both cards is identical, depicting Drifloon floating against a colorful landscape featuring red flowers, dark storm clouds, a clearing blue sky, and a rainbow. The composition, linework, and color palette match completely.

Both cards depict Volo by the artist kirisAki, but they feature entirely different compositions and poses. Image A shows a close-up dynamic angle with Volo extending his left hand toward the viewer against a rainbow background, while Image B shows Volo standing upright with hands near his hips in front of an outdoor temple scene.

Both cards feature the exact same illustration of Radiant (Shiny) Hawlucha by Masakazu Fukuda, depicting the same mid-air pose, linework, colors, and swooping multicolored background with burst lighting and white sparkles. The visible texture difference in Image A is due to the physical holofoil scan of the card.

The 3D model poses, positioning, and linework of Mewtwo and Mew are identical between both cards, featuring Mewtwo with an arm raised and tail sweeping behind Mew floating beside it. However, Image A displays the standard full-art coloration (purple-toned Mewtwo, pink Mew, and a purple faceted background), whereas Image B applies a rainbow rare treatment with a pastel gradient wash across the characters and background.

Both cards feature the identical composition and 3D linework/poses depicting Psyduck resting on top of Slowpoke's head. However, Image A displays full standard colors (yellow Psyduck and pink Slowpoke) against a vibrant blue background, while Image B applies a rainbow rare treatment with a continuous pastel rainbow gradient across the Pokémon and the background.
Both cards feature the identical full-art illustration of Ho-Oh by N-DESIGN Inc., matching in Ho-Oh's pose, linework, coloration, and the swirling colorful cosmic background.

Both cards feature the identical full-art illustration of Reshiram V by N-DESIGN Inc. The pose, linework, highlights, and orange-to-pink gradient background with light swooshes are identical. The visible visual differences are solely due to physical texture reflection in the Japanese scan (Image A) compared to the digital asset rendering in the English version (Image B).

Both cards share the exact same 3D composition, character poses, and linework of Garchomp and Giratina by aky CG Works. However, Image A features full standard coloring on a golden textured background, while Image B applies a Rainbow Rare recolor featuring a pastel multi-color gradient across the characters and background.

Both cards feature the identical Rainbow Rare artwork of Volo by kirisAki, sharing the exact same composition, linework, pastel rainbow gradient coloration, and lighting. Image A shows physical card texture/foil reflections while Image B is a smoother digital render, but the depicted artwork itself is identical.

The artwork in both cards is identical, featuring Fezandipiti perched among blooming pink blossoms with the same pose, composition, line details, and color palette. Only the card language and frame elements differ.

The cards feature completely different 3D models and poses of Charizard. In Image A, Charizard is facing to the left with its neck arched forward, right arm extended, and tail curling around on the right side. In Image B, Charizard is viewed from a lower, more frontal angle with its chest facing forward, head tilted back, and both arms raised in a different dynamic pose against a solid red background.

Both cards share the exact same 3D-rendered character models, poses, and composition featuring Machamp and Marshadow. Image A uses the standard full-art color scheme with natural Pokémon colors against an orange background, whereas Image B features a Rainbow Rare treatment with a pastel rainbow gradient overlay across the entire artwork.

Both cards feature the exact same artwork by matazo depicting Noctowl swooping forward with outstretched wings and claws, overlaid with iridescent rainbow light beams against a dark night forest background. The composition, colors, and linework are identical.

Although both cards depict the character Volo by the same illustrator (kirisAki), the artworks feature completely different compositions and poses. Image A shows a dynamic full-art close-up of Volo reaching his hand forward toward the viewer, while Image B shows Volo standing in a symmetrical pose with his arms at his sides against a background of the Temple of Sinnoh ruins and sky.

Both cards feature the identical artwork by Mina Nakai showing a Relicanth floating in an underwater cavern opening, with identical stylized linework, shading, corals, rock structures, and color palette.

Both cards feature the identical full-art illustration by OKACHEKE, depicting Paldean Wooper on a muddy path with visible footprints, white flowers in the foreground grass, other Paldean Woopers in the midground, and a Pokémon Center in the distance against a rolling green landscape.
